advisories.title: Name the issuance test after the behavior it exercises
advisories.body: The test title claims that allocation is serialized, but it executes one call with a pre-seeded latest version and does not exercise concurrent calls or a locking boundary. Rename it to cover next-version allocation, or add a separate concurrency test, so a future reader does not mistake this unit assertion for proof of the serialization invariant.
evidence: Premise: __tests__/issued-documents.test.ts:12 calls `persistIssuedDocument` once after stubbing `findFirst` to version 2 → Improvement: aligns the test name with its observable scope and keeps the serialization guarantee discoverable → Fix: rename this test to next-version allocation or add a separate concurrent-allocation test.
__tests__/issued-documents.test.ts:13-17 → the only assertions cover version 3, storage put, and inserted metadata; no competing issuance is started.

advisories.title: Name the helper for its admin-only contract
advisories.body: `requireAuth` now delegates directly to `requireAdmin`, so its broad name no longer describes the authorization boundary of every caller. Rename it to `requireAdminUser` (or call `requireAdmin` directly) to make the stronger contract visible at call sites.
evidence: Premise: app/admin/_actions/admin-actions.ts:43-45 returns only `requireAdmin()` while its name is `requireAuth` → Improvement: makes the role boundary immediately clear during maintenance and prevents callers from assuming it merely checks login → Fix: rename the helper to reflect admin authorization or inline `requireAdmin`.
rg -n 'requireAuth\(' app/admin/_actions/admin-actions.ts → the helper remains the authorization entry point for multiple admin actions.

advisories.title: Centralize the duplicated issued-PDF persistence sequence
advisories.body: Decision and contract export now repeat actor resolution, missing-actor handling, persistence, and persistence-failure mapping. Extracting a small helper parameterized by document kind and message keeps the immutable-issuance policy synchronized as export behavior evolves.
evidence: Premise: app/admin/_actions/admin-actions.ts:543-549 and 798-804 contain parallel issuance-actor lookup, null handling, `persistIssuedDocument` call, and catch mapping → Improvement: one helper gives future issuance-policy changes a single maintenance point → Fix: extract a private persistence helper accepting application id, kind, filename, PDF, actor, and localized labels.
app/admin/_actions/admin-actions.ts:543-549 → the decision path implements the complete sequence.
app/admin/_actions/admin-actions.ts:798-804 → the contract path repeats the same sequence with only kind and messages changed.

advisories.title: Remove the redundant Secretariat pre-read before updates
advisories.body: Both mutation paths first fetch the account and then run an update that already restricts its `WHERE` clause to `role = secretaria` and reports failure when no row is returned. Rely on the returned update rows directly to avoid a duplicated authorization predicate and one database round trip per action.
evidence: Premise: app/admin/_actions/staff-actions.ts:49-55 reads the same id/role predicate that the update at line 55 enforces and the result at line 56 already distinguishes zero rows → Improvement: removes duplicated policy logic and a database request without changing the externally returned generic error → Fix: issue the restricted update directly and preserve the existing `rows.length` result handling.
app/admin/_actions/staff-actions.ts:65-72 → password reset repeats the same pre-read followed by an identically restricted update.

advisories.title: Give the Secretariat donor view readable component boundaries
advisories.body: The new role-specific view places filtering, input markup, and the complete donor-card rendering tree into a few dense lines. Split the JSX into normal multiline markup and extract a small `SecretariatDonorCard` (with a named props type) so future changes to the permitted donor projection are reviewable field by field.
evidence: Premise: app/admin/benfeitores/client.tsx:93-100 combines component props, local filtering, search input, and every displayed operational donor field in one compact block → Improvement: makes privacy-sensitive field additions and UI changes locally auditable → Fix: format the component normally and extract the repeated article into a named card component.
app/admin/benfeitores/client.tsx:77-90 → `SecretariatDonorPledge` is the allowlisted projection whose fields the dense renderer consumes.
